stem.text: Which statement about the Avogadro constant is correct?

A.text: It is the mass of one mole of any element.

B.text: It is the mass of $6.02 \times 10^{23}$ atoms of any element.

C.text: It is the number of atoms in one mole of neon.

D.text: It is the number of atoms in $12\,\text{g}$ of any element.
